deliverables: Schema-locked inbound reply classifier (pipeline.classify_reply) — deterministic keyword scoring, fixed record schema, typed state for Jev (fail closed: classifier unreachable => reply deferred, never guessed).
Twenty CRM contact brief builder (pipeline.build_contact_brief) — staged upsert_contact only, write_enabled=False, DNC gate re-run on contact fields.

Aside Gate-D staged approval card builder (pipeline.build_gate_d_card) — draft-only: send_enabled=False, clients_ai_send=False, human exact-text approval, sender STOP brake via check_sender_lane_ready.
Fresh-domain trigger-event scorer (pipeline.score_trigger_event) — event-type base weight, freshness decay on age_days, evidence + domain-match bonuses, band hot/warm/cold.

Deterministic Nod/n8n blueprint (nod_workflow_blueprint.json) separating pagination/retries/sleeps (deterministic_control_plane, max_retries=3) from schema-locked AI nodes (additionalProperties=false output schemas).

citations.claim: Fresh-domain trigger-event scoring for lead qualification (score_trigger_event, n12_score_trigger_event).
n8n AI-agent node design: deterministic control flow separated from AI nodes (deterministic_control_plane vs ai_schema_locked nodes).
Reliable agent runs: bounded retries (max_retries=3), schema-locked AI outputs, idempotent writes keyed on reply_id/event_id.
Pagination/retries/sleeps owned by the deterministic control plane, never by AI nodes.

dnc.carve_out: atsHostCarveOut: employer required alongside the ATS host domain

gate_d.sender_lane: check_sender_lane_ready — STOP brake + approved_sha12 == template_sha12; auto_send always False

gates.blueprint_separation: pagination/retries/sleeps in deterministic_control_plane only; AI nodes schema-locked (additionalProperties=false); validator: pipeline.validate_blueprint

jev.policy: Typed Jev judgment before any frontier LLM call; classifier unreachable/timed out/unparseable => defer the reply untouched or escalate — never guess a verdict locally.
